ProxyVersionUpgradeOrRestart.proxyList: Empty for upgrade tasks; required for restart tasks. <li>Enter the showId of proxies to restart in batch
ProxyVersionUpgradeOrRestart.upgradeType: Task type. <li>relaunch: restart proxy; <li>latest: upgrade proxy version
ProxyVersionUpgradeOrRestart.isDefer: Whether to execute with delay, default false: <li>false: execute immediately <li>true: execute with delay (during maintenance window)
